caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a flat, roughly rectangular-shaped metal item with rounded and irregular edges. It has a weathered, rust-brown color with various shades ranging from dark to light brown, suggestive of heavy corrosion or patina. Attached to the top of the rectangular base is a solid, thick loop, also metallic and matching in color. The loop is circular with a thick rim, and it seems to form a continuous part of the main body. The drawing is centered on a plain, light beige background, with no additional objects or features. The artist’s signature, “C.C. Christo Pels,” appears at the bottom right of the image.
title: Hoe Blade
